function.name: math_roots_quadratic
function.description: Calculate the roots of a quadratic equation. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: math_roots_cubic
function.description: Calculate the roots of a cubic equation. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

a.description: Coefficient of the third-degree term. This is a float type value.

b.description: Coefficient of the second-degree term. This is a float type value.

c.description: Coefficient of the first-degree term. This is a float type value.

d.description: Constant term. This is a float type value.

function.name: math_roots_polynomial
function.description: Calculate the roots of a polynomial equation. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

coefficients.description: Array of coefficients of the polynomial equation starting from highest degree term.

degree.description: Degree of the polynomial equation. Default 0
